scenes.proposal-refused: A property offer cannot go forward after financing was declined. Alice, dark bob hair and blue sweater, sits on the left at a small property-agent desk. Ben, dark blue hair and white shirt, sits on the right and gently returns a closed blue proposal folder toward Alice while raising his other hand to pause the transaction. A small house model remains behind Ben, beyond the closed folder. Alice understands the refusal, disappointed but calm. No signature, no handshake, no transfer of keys, no successful handoff. Medium wide shot of the complete desk and the two characters, with generous white margins. This is the property agent refusing the proposal, distinctly different from a bank declining financing.

The thick confidential application remains under the adviser's other hand behind the desk. Warm close view of the decisive handoff; complete hands and sheet visible.
